#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u

in=/home/eval/data/inventory.txt
out_sku=/home/eval/data/sku_totals.txt
out_wh=/home/eval/data/warehouses.txt

declare -A sku_total=()
declare -A wh_sku_qty=()
declare -A warehouses=()

if [[ -f "$in" ]]; then
  while IFS=$' \t' read -r w s q rest || [[ -n "${w:-}" ]]; do
    w=${w%$'\r'}; s=${s:-}; s=${s%$'\r'}; q=${q:-}; q=${q%$'\r'}
    [[ -z "$w" || "$w" == \#* ]] && continue
    [[ -z "$s" ]] && continue

    warehouses[$w]=1
    key="$w|$s"
    wh_sku_qty[$key]=$(( ${wh_sku_qty[$key]:-0} + q ))
  done < "$in"
fi

declare -A wh_count=()
for w in "${!warehouses[@]}"; do wh_count[$w]=0; done
for key in "${!wh_sku_qty[@]}"; do
  if (( ${wh_sku_qty[$key]} > 0 )); then
    w=${key%%|*}
    wh_count[$w]=$(( ${wh_count[$w]} + 1 ))
  fi
done

{
  for s in "${!sku_total[@]}"; do
    printf '%s %s\n' "$s" "${sku_total[$s]}"
  done
} | LC_ALL=C sort -k1,1 > "$out_sku"

{
  for w in "${!wh_count[@]}"; do
    printf '%s %s\n' "$w" "${wh_count[$w]}"
  done
} | LC_ALL=C sort -k1,1 > "$out_wh"

#!/bin/bash

rotate() {
    local logfile="$1" keep="$2"
    local f suffix n
    local -a nums=()

    for f in "$logfile".*; do
        [[ -e "$f" ]] || continue
        suffix="${f#"$logfile".}"
        if [[ "$suffix" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            nums+=("$suffix")
        fi
    done

    if (( ${#nums[@]} > 0 )); then
        local sorted
        sorted=$(printf '%s\n' "${nums[@]}" | sort -rn)
        while IFS= read -r suffix; do
            [[ -n "$suffix" ]] || continue
            n=$((10#$suffix))
            if (( n + 1 > keep )); then
                rm -f -- "$logfile.$suffix"
            else
                mv -f -- "$logfile.$suffix" "$logfile.$((n + 1))"

        done <<< "$sorted"
    fi

        if (( keep >= 1 )); then
            mv -f -- "$logfile" "$logfile.1"
        else
            rm -f -- "$logfile"
        fi
    fi
    : > "$logfile"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

APP=/home/eval/app
VFILE="$APP/VERSION"
CHANGES="$APP/changes.txt"
CHLOG="$APP/CHANGELOG.md"
DATE="2026-10-09"

old=$(head -n1 "$VFILE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
IFS=. read -r maj min pat <<< "$old"
maj=$((10#${maj:-0})); min=$((10#${min:-0})); pat=$((10#${pat:-0}))

bump=patch
entries=()
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
  line=${line%$'\r'}
  [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
  if [[ "$line" == BREAKING* ]] || [[ "$line" =~ ^[A-Za-z]+(\([^\)]*\))?!: ]]; then
    bump=major
  elif [[ "$line" =~ ^feat(\([^\)]*\))?: ]]; then
    [[ $bump == patch ]] && bump=minor
  fi
  if [[ "$line" =~ ^(feat|fix)(\([^\)]*\))?!?: ]]; then
    entries+=("$line")
  fi
done < "$CHANGES"

case $bump in
  major) maj=$((maj+1)); min=0; pat=0 ;;
  minor) min=$((min+1)); pat=0 ;;
  patch) pat=$((pat+1)) ;;
esac
new="$maj.$min.$pat"

printf '%s\n' "$new" > "$VFILE"

block=$(mktemp)
{
  printf '\n## %s (%s)\n' "$new" "$DATE"
  for e in "${entries[@]+"${entries[@]}"}"; do
    printf -- '- %s\n' "$e"
  done
} > "$block"

tmp=$(mktemp)
awk -v bf="$block" '
  { print }
  !done && $0 ~ /^## Unreleased[[:space:]]*$/ {
    while ((getline l < bf) > 0) print l
    close(bf); done=1
  }
' "$CHLOG" > "$tmp"
cat "$tmp" > "$CHLOG"
rm -f "$tmp" "$block"

echo "$old -> $new"
exit 0
